body:
I was cautious about ever doin ecstacy but had smoked weed for a few years. My brother had done ex before and he had told me how class it was. One night in a friends apartment, we were all bored so my brother suggested we do a tab. Four of us took a 'pink heart' each. After a half an hour i felt nothing and was very anxious to see what the effects would be like. An hour later still nothing. Then we took another. About 5 nimutes later i got de rush and it was immense. I was on cloud nine. I was able to open up to all around me and felt very attached to my brother and my other mates. We stayed up right through the night listening to music. When I closed my eyes I felt like I was drifting in space and didnt want the sun to come up as quickly as it did! I now feel I am closer to my brother and my other mates and cant wait to do ex again.
It was easy to keep popping them without realising. - I took 5 that night and was buzzin for 2 days-class.
